ideas.idea: Render the FAQ questions and answers as visible text on the page
ideas.why: The report says the FAQ script is in moorings.astro, but it is in index.astro, and a visible FAQ is not required.

ideas.idea: Add a sizes and prices table to back up the moorings description
ideas.why: The moorings description promises sizes and prices, but the page only says prices start at £40 a night.

ideas.idea: Add the email address to the contact page, or fix its description
ideas.why: The contact description mentions email but the body only has a phone number.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness structured data for phone and location
ideas.why: The contact page has a phone number and the pages name Falmouth, so this fits the repo.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta tags and a main element
ideas.why: Base.astro has no charset or viewport meta, and the body has no main element.

ideas.idea: Use one spelling of Harbor or harbour
ideas.why: The files mix 'Harbor' and 'harbour', and people search with one spelling.

ideas.idea: Set the site option in an astro config file
ideas.why: This is accurate, but the canonical and sitemap are hardcoded, so setting site changes little here.

ideas.idea: Remove the max-snippet:0 default or use index, follow as the default
ideas.why: This is the known max-snippet problem restated.
